title: 打电话预约 · 改时间
intro: 电话里没有表情和口型，最难的是没听清时怎么说。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, Riverside Dental. How can I help?
sentences.zh: 下午好，河畔牙科。有什么可以帮您？

sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to book a cleaning appointment, please.
Of course. Are you a patient with us already?
sentences.zh: 好的。您是我们的老病人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I came in last spring. My name is Li Wei.
sentences.zh: 是的，去年春天来过。我叫李伟。

sentences.en: Got it. We have Thursday at three or Friday morning at ten.
sentences.zh: 找到了。周四下午三点或者周五上午十点。

sentences.en: Thursday works better for me. How long will it take?
sentences.zh: 周四更合适。大概要多久？

sentences.en: About forty minutes. Please arrive ten minutes early.
sentences.zh: 四十分钟左右。请提前十分钟到。

sentences.en: Sorry, could you repeat that? The line is a bit noisy.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍吗？信号有点吵。
sentences.tip: 没听清就用这句，比「pardon?」自然。

sentences.en: Ten minutes early, please. And bring your insurance card.
sentences.zh: 请提前十分钟到，带上医保卡。

sentences.en: Got it. See you on Thursday.
